parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame forms the main structural body of the storage cabinet, made of plywood panels.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and houses the shelves and doors, maintaining the cabinet’s shape and stability.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that supports all other components.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: A horizontal plywood shelf inside the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It supports stored items and divides the cabinet interior into compartments.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed or occasionally adjustable but does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: A middle shelf made of plywood, part of the cabinet’s internal structure.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a surface for storing items within the cabinet.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: Another internal shelf made of plywood.
parts.Functional_description: It divides the cabinet space and supports stored objects.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move during operation.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: An upper shelf made of plywood, part of the cabinet’s internal structure.
parts.Functional_description: It provides additional storage space for smaller or lighter items.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: A front door panel made of MDF with a handle for opening and closing.
parts.Functional_description: It covers and protects the contents of the cabinet while allowing access.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: A second MDF door panel located on the upper section of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the upper storage compartment.
parts.Movement_description: It swings open and closed on hinges.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: A lower MDF door panel forming part of the cabinet’s front.
parts.Functional_description: It conceals and protects the lower storage area.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates on hinges for access.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: Another MDF door panel located on the opposite side of the cabinet front.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the adjacent compartment.
parts.Movement_description: It swings open and closed using hinges.
